title: Simulation causes Alembic Avatar to Reset
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/075e02f79c6d4b4689c7813c499c61b7/images/9cea28cde3e24a6d8c30c8a61f948e97Issue.png)

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BmwsMDTddiM?start=0

Hey guys, does anybody know how to fix this issue?  
  
I used to be able to import an Alembic Avatar, reposition and rotate it, run the simulation, which would drape the clothes over the Alembic Avatar, and then play the Alembic Avatar animation so the cloth would follow and react to the animation.   
Now when I start the start the simulation, the Alembic Avatar resets to its default position it's in upon first importing it into the scene, causing the cloth to distort.   
Simulation Settings are Normal (Default), using GPU(same happens with CPU though) and Particle Distance of all cloth is set to 20mm.  
Latest graphics drivers and Marvelous Designer versions are installed.   
Any help would be much appreciated!

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Please share your project file with us through our 'Contact Us' page.🙏🏻https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/075e02f79c6d4b4689c7813c499c61b7 will be the best way to see what is going on there.
content_description: This web page serves as a community support forum for troubleshooting issues with importing and simulating Alembic Avatars in Marvelous Designer.

title: Rendering issue help
content:
![a15a68209adb4ce1b128e42565177a45](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/8bec5cde7f554fa7974057db6f635952/images/a15a68209adb4ce1b128e42565177a45Screenshot%202026-01-07%20221510.png)![a7ba4690dc684f7a963b10fb88003721](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/8bec5cde7f554fa7974057db6f635952/images/a7ba4690dc684f7a963b10fb88003721Screenshot%202026-01-07%20221955.png)![adb36c492ed0403c8233e4e7449a2cde](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/8bec5cde7f554fa7974057db6f635952/images/adb36c492ed0403c8233e4e7449a2cdeScreenshot%202026-01-07%20222023.png)Dear All,

Hope you're doing great. 

I have an issue with render, when I click Render, the pop-up showing "V-ray cant run, because of the required V-ray library could not located in current environment". so any one could help me to fix this? Thanks in advance.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi again! I wrote to the support and got a solution that worked for me, so for anybody else bumping into this issue in the future:Uninstall CLO software and reinstall CLO with admin rights. Right-click the CLO installer, select "Run as administrator," and follow the on-screen instructions.
Reply 1: Thank you

Comment 2: Hi, I also have this issue and have tried all steps provided in this thread and in the link provided in the error-message. I've also updated drivers for my gpu and I'm well above the recomended specs. Is there a solution to this problem?

Comment 3: Hi Ariel, Thank you for the details shared, and please note I have tried in multiple ways, even I clicked in render view, nothing works and I have attached images which property editor details are shown. Kindly look into this suggest to fix this issue. Thanks ~ Govind

Comment 4: Hi There. For the Interactive Render to be turned on you do need to either click into the Render window or the Turn on Interactive Render. Circled in the attached screenshotIf the Render engine does not activate after turning on Interactive Render. Please see below articles as you may need to Update your computers Graphics Card or grant CLO disc access-https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/8bec5cde7f554fa7974057db6f635952 also check that you computer does meet the specs required to run CLO-https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/8bec5cde7f554fa7974057db6f635952 future we do recommend posting to just here first. Your support ticket went to our account support, which would not be able to answer you. If needed we would tell you to instead send to tech support if we cannot help here
content_description: This web page serves as a support forum for users seeking assistance with V-ray rendering issues and troubleshooting.
